items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce addressing multiple critical vulnerabilities
items.summary: This bulletin addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including critical arbitrary code execution flaws like CVE-2026-103849 (template engine injection, CVSS 10.0) and CVE-2026-92909 (incorrect authorization in B2B, CVSS 9.8). Adobe is not aware of active exploitation for these specific issues.

items.title: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type (PolyShell)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.6) allows an unauthenticated attacker to upload a dangerous file type, leading to arbitrary code execution and potential control over a victim's account or session. It has been actively exploited in the wild, with CISA adding it to their KEV catalog on October 27, 2026.

items.title: Unauthenticated Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) / Remote Code Execution (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This maximum-severity zero-day vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution by injecting malicious PHP code into the template engine's 'styles' property. It has been actively exploited in the wild to deploy backdoors and web shells.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to unauthenticated customer account takeover
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows an unauthenticated attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account, gaining access to private data. Exploitation attempts were observed shortly after disclosure, and CISA added it to their KEV catalog on September 24, 2026.

items.title: Security update addressing multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities
items.summary: This bulletin resolves eight vulnerabilities, including critical stored cross-site scripting (CVE-2026-76200, CVE-2026-76201, CVSS 9.3) and incorrect authorization flaws, which could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Adobe was not aware of in-the-wild exploitation at the time of publication.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: This high-severity stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: This high-severity stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 7.7) could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Adobe Commerce B2B)
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.6) affects Adobe Commerce B2B and could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.5) could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
items.summary: This vulnerability, addressed in APSB26-73, is categorized as Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output (CWE-116). Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: This stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability (CWE-79) was resolved in APSB26-73. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability (CWE-863) was addressed in APSB26-73. Successful exploitation could lead to privilege escalation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: This incorrect authorization vulnerability (CWE-863) was resolved in APSB26-73. Successful exploitation could lead to privilege escalation.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: This stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability (CWE-79) was addressed in APSB26-73. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: This medium-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 6.5) could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.
